conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages subject to employment taxes.

conditions.label: Operates outside Delaware
conditions.description: Does business in another state, which usually means registering there as a foreign corporation.

profileFields.label: Corporation name
profileFields.description: The name on the certificate of incorporation.

profileFields.label: Delaware file number
profileFields.description: The file number the Division of Corporations gave the corporation.

profileFields.label: EIN
profileFields.description: The employer identification number from the IRS.

profileFields.label: Registered agent in Delaware
profileFields.description: Name and Delaware address of the registered agent.

profileFields.label: Principal place of business
profileFields.description: Where the business is run from.

profileFields.label: Authorized shares
profileFields.description: The number of shares the certificate of incorporation authorizes; it affects the franchise tax.

roles.label: Officer
roles.description: CEO, president, secretary, treasurer or another officer.

roles.label: Incorporator
roles.description: Signed and filed the certificate of incorporation.

setupSteps.title: Choose the name
setupSteps.description: Reserving it is optional and holds it for 120 days.

setupSteps.title: Appoint a registered agent in Delaware
setupSteps.description: Delaware law requires a registered agent with a physical Delaware address.

setupSteps.title: File the certificate of incorporation
setupSteps.description: Filed online or by mail; it sets the authorized shares.

setupSteps.title: Adopt bylaws, appoint directors and officers, issue shares
setupSteps.description: Usually done by the incorporator and the first board.

setupSteps.title: Get an EIN
setupSteps.description: Apply online with the IRS for free; the number is issued at once if approved.

setupSteps.title: Decide on an S corporation election
setupSteps.description: A C corporation is the default. Eligible corporations can elect S status with Form 2553.

setupSteps.title: Register in the states where you operate
setupSteps.description: Doing business in another state usually requires registering there as a foreign corporation.

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks may ask for a good standing certificate or a certified copy of the filing.

setupSteps.title: Beneficial ownership report: not needed
setupSteps.description: FinCEN's rules now exempt companies created in the United States from BOI reporting; only some foreign companies registered in the US report.

obligations.title: Delaware annual report and franchise tax
obligations.description: Due on or before March 1 for the previous year, filed online. The tax depends on the method: a minimum of $175 with the authorized shares method and $400 with the assumed par value capital method; the report filing fee is $50 for non-exempt corporations.

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return (Form 1120)
obligations.description: Due by the 15th day of the 4th month after the tax year ends (April 15 for a calendar year; a June 30 year end has other rules).

obligations.title: Corporate estimated tax payments
obligations.description: Corporations generally pay estimated tax if they expect to owe $500 or more. Check the installment dates with the IRS.

obligations.title: Reports in other states
obligations.description: Each state where the corporation is registered may require its own annual report and taxes.

obligations.title: Employer's quarterly federal tax return (Form 941)
obligations.description: File by the last day of the month after each quarter: April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31. If all taxes were deposited on time, you have 10 more days.

obligations.title: Forms W-2 to employees and the SSA
obligations.description: Report each employee's wages and withholding for the previous year.

obligations.title: Federal unemployment tax return (Form 940)
obligations.description: Report FUTA wages for the previous year by January 31 (10 more days if all FUTA tax was deposited on time).

obligations.title: Forms 1099-NEC for contractors
obligations.description: File with the IRS and send to each contractor you paid above the reporting threshold, by January 31.
